title: Chintamani Library v2.3.2 (Build 2036) — Multi-Branch Separation & Portal Sync
releaseNotes: Branch-Separated Complaints: Dedicated 3-way toggle (All Branches, Khalilabad, Mehdawal) in Complaints screen. Mehdawal complaints show strictly in Mehdawal; Khalilabad in Khalilabad
Branch-Separated Registrations: Registrations strictly compartmentalized by branch context with dedicated filter badges
Branch-Aware Members Directory: Active branch switcher and indicators in directory header
Universal Portal Sync: Fixed branch resolution in backend so student complaints, admissions, and payments cleanly route to the correct branch
Pure 35MB arm64 Package: Fast, smooth update delivery directly within the app
